title: Refund Schedule for Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Membership Fees
content:
A **Kestrel Care Rewards** Plus membership fee is refunded on cancellation according to when the cancellation falls after the fee was charged.

## Refund rule

1. **Full refund.** A fee is refunded in full when the membership is cancelled no later than the level's refund window in calendar days after the fee was charged; a cancellation on the last day of the window still receives the full refund.
2. **After the window.** Where the level refunds unused months, the unused whole months are refunded, each at the membership fee divided by the number of months in the billing cycle, rounded to the cent half up. Where the level does not refund unused months, nothing is refunded after the window.
3. **Once only.** A fee is refunded at most once.

## Schedule by level

| Level | Membership fee per billing cycle (USD) | Billing cycle (calendar months) | Full-refund window (calendar days after the fee is charged) | Unused whole months refunded after the window |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | 5.00 | 1 | 14 | no |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | 48.00 | 12 | 30 | yes |

## Worked refunds (hypothetical dates and cancellation points)

**Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly.** A 5.00 fee is charged on 5 March. The full-refund window runs 14 days, to 19 March.

| Cancelled on | Refund |
|---|---|
| 19 March | 5.00 in full |
| 20 March | nothing — unused months are not refunded at this level |

**Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual.** A 48.00 fee is charged on 1 June. The full-refund window runs 30 days, to 1 July.

| Cancelled on | Refund |
|---|---|
| 1 July | 48.00 in full |
| a later date, with 7 unused whole months of the cycle | each unused whole month at 48.00 divided by 12, which is 4.00 and needs no rounding; 7 months at 4.00 each: 28.00 |
| a later date, with 11 unused whole months of the cycle | 11 months at 4.00 each: 44.00 |

**The same fee a second time.** A fee that has already been refunded is not refunded again.
